construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

Three-phase master plan on VTA land. Phase one, Tamien Station Apartments (135 units), opened and is separate record SCC-000480. Mid-2025 the developers cut one remaining phase from 219 market-rate to 132 affordable units; full build-out now expected at over 400 units.

City of San Jose permit PD20-003 (Planned Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2020), status Approved, issue date 2020-12-09: "Planned Development Permit to allow the demolition of a 11,400 square foot building and construction of a mixed-use development consisting of 569 residential units (Option A) or 555 residential units (Option B) within three buildings, up to 3,000 square f" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

VTA project page: Exclusive Negotiation Agreement fall 2017; Joint Development Agreement and Ground Lease Agreement summer 2018; Lease Option Agreement amended September 1, 2022 to extend it 18 months and reduce parking spaces. Phase 1 (135 affordable units) broke ground October 18, 2023 and held its ribbon cutting January 23, 2026. Phase 2 construction expected around fall 2026; Phase 3 is market-rate apartments, no date given. The Phase 2 amendment reduces units from 219 (Option A) or 213 (Option B) to 132, all affordable, on about 5.33 gross acres.

CTCAC CA-26-616 (September 1, 2026): Tamien Station Phase II, 1221 Lick Avenue & 1184 Lelong Street, 1.92-acre site, 132 units (131 restricted, 1 manager's unit): 62 one-bedroom, 37 two-bedroom, 33 three-bedroom, one building, rents at 30%-70% AMI (15 at 30%, 16 at 50%, 50 at 60%, 50 at 70%). Recommended $5,095,713 annual federal credits, $9,979,182 total state credits and $27,050,000 tax-exempt bond cap; state Mixed-Income Program funding through CalHFA. Total development cost at application $107,542,787. Construction expected December 2026 to September 2028. General partners Core Tamien II, LLC, Republic Tamien II LLC and CVCAH Tamien II LLC. Phase II is not a separate record.
